segments.title: Can you get all 3 right?
segments.say: Three quick quiz questions. Can you get all three right? Number one.

segments.title: Which planet has most moons?
segments.say: Quick quiz. Which planet has the most moons?

segments.title: Pick one
segments.say: Is it Jupiter, Saturn, or Neptune? Lock it in. Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Way more than any planet
segments.say: NASA counts well over two hundred seventy confirmed moons. Far more than any other planet.

segments.title: Most are tiny
segments.say: Most are tiny, just a few miles across.

segments.title: World's biggest desert?
segments.say: Number two. Quick quiz. What's the biggest desert on Earth?

segments.title: Pick one
segments.say: Sahara, Gobi, or Antarctica? Lock it in. Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Desert = very little rain
segments.say: A desert is about how little rain or snow falls, not how hot it is.

segments.title: About 14 million km²
segments.say: Britannica lists the Antarctic ice sheet at about fourteen million square kilometers.

segments.title: Tallest mountain? Not Everest
segments.say: Number three. Quick quiz. The tallest mountain on Earth is not Everest.

segments.title: Pick one
segments.say: Measured from base to peak, is it K2, Mauna Kea, or Kilimanjaro? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Most of it is underwater
segments.say: About six thousand meters of it is under the ocean.

segments.title: Over 10,000 m base to top
segments.say: Base to peak, it's about ten thousand two hundred meters. Taller than Everest above sea level.

segments.title: Quick recap
bullets: Tallest base to peak: Mauna Kea
segments.say: Quick recap: Most moons: Saturn. Biggest desert: Antarctica. Tallest base to peak: Mauna Kea.

segments.title: COMMENT BELOW
segments.say: How many did you get? Comment your score out of three, and follow Nexora for Part 2.
